operations.rationale: The unpublished draft reduced member hits while increasing unannotated proposals, chiefly through long definition chains and broad nearby-span expansion. This final revision keeps the useful structural corrections evidenced by cases 147, 114, 151, 196 and 620, but limits definition blocks to contiguous list items, pairs compelled-disclosure language locally, preserves return clauses for nda-20, and avoids the draft's positive-only sharing selection. Cases 229, 316, 108, 622 and 468 further support separate handling of governing leads, actor definitions, termination conditions, and scoped exceptions.
